subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: How should a managed Memory Dreaming cron run report status when the outer isolated turn is handled but Dreaming produces no diary entry or records one or more workspace failures?
rationale: Current code can treat the trigger as handled while logging workspace failures locally, and deciding whether that should become cron error, skipped/degraded status, doctor output, or a memory-core status warning is a maintainer-owned product contract.

options.title: Surface degraded Dreaming status
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved degraded/diagnostic path so cron or memory status shows failed/no-op Dreaming sweeps without marking every handled maintenance run as a hard cron error.

options.title: Make workspace failures hard cron errors
options.body: Propagate failed workspace counts to the cron result so `cron list` and run history clearly fail when any Dreaming workspace fails, accepting stricter scheduling semantics.

options.title: Close after live non-repro
options.body: Run a current-release live reproduction and close only if managed Dreaming now writes diary/state or exposes sufficient diagnostics for the reported setup.

recommendation.title: Surface degraded Dreaming status
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved degraded/diagnostic path so cron or memory status shows failed/no-op Dreaming sweeps without marking every handled maintenance run as a hard cron error.

likelyOwner.reason: PR 91056 already owned the related state migration and is the strongest current history signal for the remaining state/diagnostics decision.
